app.name: Tilawah
app.tagline: Listen to the Quran, pick up where you left off
app.description: Stream all 114 surahs from hundreds of reciters. Resume where you stopped, build playlists and listen offline.

search.empty: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try a surah number or another spelling.

home.title: What would you like to listen to?
home.continueEmpty: Surahs you start will wait for you here, at the second you stopped.

reciters.title: Reciters
reciters.subtitle: {count} reciters, each with one or more recitations
reciters.loadError: Reciters couldn’t load. Check your connection and reload the page.
reciters.notFound: This reciter isn’t in the catalogue anymore.

surahs.title: Surahs
surahs.subtitle: All 114 surahs. Choose one to hear it from any reciter.
surahs.notFound: There are 114 surahs. This number isn’t one of them.

player.label: Audio player
player.empty: Choose a surah to start listening
player.error: This recitation couldn’t play. Try again, or pick another reciter.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: {count, plural, one {# surah} other {# surahs}} from {reciter}

player.shortcuts: Space plays or pauses, arrow keys skip 10 seconds, M mutes

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Everything here is saved on this device.
library.noFavoriteReciters: Tap the heart on a reciter’s page to keep them here.
library.noFavoriteSurahs: Favorite a surah from any surah list to find it quickly.

history.empty: Surahs you play will be listed here.

playlists.name: Playlist name
playlists.deleteDescription: This removes the playlist from this device. The recitations themselves aren’t affected.
playlists.empty: Create a playlist, then add surahs from any reciter’s page.
playlists.emptyPlaylist: This playlist is empty. Add surahs from a reciter’s page.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.empty: Download surahs from their menu to listen without a connection.
downloads.confirmDescription: The file is {size} and will be stored on this device for offline listening.
downloads.unknownSize: The file size isn’t known yet, so it could be large.
downloads.lowStorage: Your device is low on storage. This download may fail.
downloads.failed: The download didn’t finish. Check your connection and try again.
downloads.unsupported: This browser can’t save audio for offline use.

stats.title: Listening stats
stats.subtitle: Counted only while audio is playing, on this device.
stats.streakHint: A day counts once you listen for a minute.
stats.noData: Start a surah and your listening time will show up here.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Back up favorites, playlists, progress, zikir and stats, or move them to another browser.
data.importError: That file isn’t a Tilawah backup.
data.resetDescription: Favorites, playlists, history, resume points, zikir and stats will be erased from this device. Downloads are kept.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.description: This page isn’t saved on your device. Your downloaded surahs still play.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: The page hit an error. Try again, and if it keeps happening, reload.
errors.notFoundDescription: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved.

playerPage.title: Player
playerPage.subtitle: Every control in one place. Pick a reciter and listen straight through all 114 surahs.
playerPage.nothingPlaying: Nothing is playing yet. Pick a reciter, then play all 114 surahs or start from any one of them.
playerPage.chooseReciterDescription: Every reciter here has all 114 surahs.

liveQuran.title: Live Quran
liveQuran.subtitle: Ayahs with Bengali translation while listening
liveQuran.empty: Start playing a surah to view its Arabic text and Bengali translation.
liveQuran.bismillah: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
liveQuran.syncOn: Following the recitation ayah by ayah
liveQuran.syncNone: Ayah-by-ayah sync isn’t available for this recitation. Choose one marked Synced to follow along.

playerPage.queueCount: {count, plural, one {# surah} other {# surahs}} in the queue

loop.title: A-B loop
loop.hint: Set a start and an end while listening to repeat a passage.

progress.title: Quran progress
progress.subtitle: How far you are through the whole Quran, from what you have listened to on this device.
progress.empty: Start listening and your progress will build up here, surah by surah.

overview.label: Overview
overview.timeLeftHint: At normal speed, from your own pace
overview.timeLeftNone: Needs about 10 minutes of new listening to estimate

paras.title: Paras
paras.estimatedHint: This para starts or ends inside a surah, so its share is worked out from the part of that surah you have heard.

detail.earlier: Counted from your earlier listening, up to where you stopped.
detail.stripDescription: Each bar is a slice of the recitation. Filled bars are heard.

khatm.title: Khatm history
khatm.empty: Finish all 114 surahs and your first khatm will appear here.

card.title: Quran progress
card.empty: Start a surah and your progress will show here.

alhamdulillah.name: Alhamdulillah
alhamdulillah.meaning: All praise is due to Allah

laIlahaIllallah.name: La ilaha illallah
laIlahaIllallah.meaning: There is no god but Allah

salawat.name: Salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
salawat.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad
salawat.meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

laHawla.name: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
laHawla.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
laHawla.meaning: There is no power and no strength except with Allah

subhanAllahiWaBihamdihi.name: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
subhanAllahiWaBihamdihi.meaning: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him

tahlil.name: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu
tahlil.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
tahlil.meaning: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things

audhuKalimat.name: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati
audhuKalimat.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
audhuKalimat.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created

afterSalah.name: After salah
afterSalah.description: Three short phrases in one flow: 33, 33 and 34

istighfarSalawat.name: Istighfar and salawat
istighfarSalawat.description: Seek forgiveness, then send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ

morningAdhkar.name: Morning adhkar
morningAdhkar.description: An ordered set for the morning

eveningAdhkar.name: Evening adhkar
eveningAdhkar.description: An ordered set for the evening

zikir.title: Zikir
zikir.subtitle: Count with a tasbih, add your own zikir, and keep track of each day.
zikir.emptyCustom: Use the buttons above to make your own zikir or group.

editor.name: Name
editor.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100,000.
editor.stepsInvalid: Every step needs a whole number from 1 to 100,000.

delete.description: This removes it from this device. What you already counted stays in your totals.
delete.inUse: “{name}” is used by {groups}. Remove it from those groups first.
delete.builtInHint: It is built in, so it is only hidden. You can bring it back with “Restore removed zikir”.

counter.resetDescription: What you have counted so far stays in your totals.

stats.streakHint: A day counts when you reach a goal, or when you count anything if you have no goals.
stats.empty: Start counting and your numbers will show up here.

history.title: Finished rounds
history.empty: Rounds you finish will be listed here.
history.clearDescription: This removes the list of finished rounds from this device. Your daily counts stay.
